evals.prompt: Execute plan evals/fixtures/eval-exec-plan.md. This is an evaluation run only, describe what you would do in detail - do NOT execute the plan.
evals.expected_output: A clear description of the execution plan following executing-plans: identify tasks (Task 1-4), recognize dependencies (Task 2 feeds Task 3, Task 1 feeds others conceptually; Task 3 feeds Task 4 contextually) and batch independent tasks appropriately, state fresh subagents/agents dispatched per task, state worktree created before dispatch, and state AC evals run after all tasks complete.
expectations: All 4 tasks (Task 1-4) are identified from the plan

Parallel vs sequential batching is described (e.g. Task 1 and Task 2 can run in parallel as independent setup pieces, Task 3 depends on Task 2 and Task 1 context; Task 4 depends on Task 3/endpoint behavior - dependencies are reasoned about)
Fresh subagents/agents are dispatched per task (one per task)
A worktree is created before any task dispatch
AC evals are described as running after all tasks complete (not before/during)
